snippet.title: Finding Frankie 2 - Official Trailer World Premiere - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A World Premiere Trailer for Finding Frankie 2. Finding Frankie 2 invites YOU to a true experience of terror as you compete in a terrifyingly twisted parkour show. Stealthily navigate around horrifying characters and swing through challenging parkour courses. This is one game show you won’t want to miss! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
